campaign_notes.expedition_abandoned_pilg.text: the expedition left the pilgrim behind.

campaign_notes.exterminated_the_alien_pa.text: the investigators exterminated the alien parasites.

campaign_notes.did_not_confront_the_nigh.text: the investigators did not confront the nightmare.

campaign_notes.cthulhu_annihilated_the_c.text: Cthulhu annihilated the city of Arkham.

one_first_last_job.title: One First Last Job
one_first_last_job.text: Complete The Drowned City campaign once on any difficulty.

season_two.title: Season Two
season_two.text: Play through the campaign on hard or expert mode using 4 investigators from 4 different previous campaigns.

cliff.title: Cliff Diver
cliff.text: Complete the campaign without ever bringing a diving suit along.

coup.title: This is a Coup
coup.text: Defeat both Naomi O’Bannion and Sadie Sheldon in One Last Job using only the act 3a parley ability.

search.title: Thorough Search
search.text: End The Western Wall with every location revealed.

tidal_flip.title: Tidal Flip Minigame
tidal_flip.text: Complete The Drowned Quarter with each location revealed and not flooded.

kill_the_adds.title: Kill the Adds
kill_the_adds.text: Defeat Mother in The Apiary using only her Forced effect.

deep_end.title: In The Deep End
deep_end.text: Escape The Grand Vault with the Tidal Tablet after every location has been fully flooded.

sorry.title: Sorry, Didn’t See You There
sorry.text: Beat Court of the Ancients without moving the Great Lift after the Colossal Tyrant spawns.

sky_rider.title: Sky Rider
sky_rider.text: End your turn in open sky at least 5 times during a single game of Obsidian Canyons.

skip_to_the_end.title: Skip to the End
skip_to_the_end.text: Defeat Cthulhu in Sepulchre of the Sleeper.

alien_dropout.title: Alien School Dropout
alien_dropout.text: Complete the campaign without translating a single alien glyph.

alien_grad.title: Alien School Graduate
alien_grad.text: Translate all 26 alien glyphs during a single playthrough of The Drowned City campaign.

empty_handed.title: Empty Handed
empty_handed.text: Return from R'lyeh without having collected any [[Artifact]] story assets.

stay_dead.title: WHY. WON’T. YOU. STAY. DEAD?!
stay_dead.text: Add The Inescapable to the victory display at least 20 times during a single campaign.

powers_combined.title: With Your Powers Combined…
powers_combined.text: Finish The Drowned City campaign having earned the following artifacts:

obligations.title: Obligations
obligations.text: Finish The Drowned City campaign with the following tasks completed:

line_in_the_sand.title: Line in the Sand
line_in_the_sand.text: Win The Drowned City campaign with at least three Ultimatums active.

expertise.title: R’lyeh Expertise
expertise.text: Win The Drowned City campaign on Expert difficulty.
